create_Net_model: create a Net model with configurable num_actions, input_channels, and optional LSTM for Atari RL
run_Net_forward: run the Net forward pass with state, reward, prev_action inputs to get policy logits and actions
create_model_from_flags: create a Net model from flags object with use_lstm setting and move to specified device
review_Net_initial_state: review the Net initial_state method that returns LSTM hidden and cell states for batch inference
test_Net_resnet_blocks: test the Net resnet1 and resnet2 residual blocks with feature convolutions for Atari image processing
